about: More tokens for the Robinhood Chain MAINNET (4663) factory of the redeploy (gate ROBINHOOD-REDEPLOY), whose admin is the team's 2-of-2 Safe itself: no timelock, so the Safe lists them with one batch of setAsset calls on the factory that both owners sign once (pnpm ops:add-assets --safe-files writes it as the Safe app's Transaction Builder file, 4663-assets-3.safe.json beside this one). Gate LIST-13 (Thom and Rodrigo, 2026-10-23) asked for thirteen: AMC, COST, DJT, GLXY, GME, HIMS, LLY, MRNA, RBLX, RDDT, SNAP, SNDK, TTWO. One meets the bar of WIDER-LIST: GME, through its Uniswap v3 pool (`v3Pool`), listed on chain now and kept out of the app until it builds a v3 route, like QQQ (`hidden`). Eleven have no Chainlink feed on the chain, and SNDK has no pool that fills $1,000 each way for 1% or less (docs/vault/MAINNET-LIST-13.md). The entry is of the deploy file's shape (script/config/4663.json), held to the same rules: a Chainlink feed that names its aggregator and is live; a pool against USDG that fills $1,000 each way for 1% or less with its mid within 2% of the feed; maxTradeUsd the largest size asked that cost 1% or less each way; maxWeightBps DESIGN-VAULT section 6 on the pool's sale capacity; average the deepest Uniswap v3 pool against USDG keeping more than 3,600 observations. The keeper stays off: flags 0, no average feed, no range. Every value is PROPOSED: the Safe's two owners confirm them by signing the batch. Figures read by packages/chain-evm/test/pool-quotes.ts (method pool-quotes-0.3) at the block in `measured`; raw reads in fixtures/risk-evm/robinhood-list-13-quotes.json.

assets.name: GameStop
assets.maxWeightNote: Proposed 2026-10-23: 500 bps, the ceiling in a shared portfolio (gate EXIT-SOURCE); a person's own vault is not capped. By DESIGN-VAULT section 6 (10,000 x 0.25 x capacity / $50,000, down to a 50 bps step, at most 5000), with capacity $10,000: the largest of $1,000, $10,000, $50,000 and $250,000 the v3 pool below took as a sale for 1% or less. One reading; Bearing has no curve for GME's pools in the repository.
assets.v3PoolNote: Proposed 2026-10-23 (listed now, traded once the app builds a v3 route, as QQQ; it stays out of the app until then). GME has no v4 route: its deepest hookless v4 pool against USDG (fee 10000, spacing 200) costs 41.7% to buy and 10.4% to sell $1,000, and no other v4 pool fills $1,000. This is its Uniswap v3 pool against USDG with the most liquidity in range among those that fill $1,000 each way for 1% or less within 2% of the feed, the v3 factory's own, fee 500, at block 96096520 (2026-10-23T16:59:24.000Z); the deeper fee-10000 pool costs 1.02% at $1,000. Quoted by Bearing's ClQuoter through a state override, cost against its own mid, fee included, in bps to trade in / out: $1,000 12.2/12.2, $2,500 23/23, $5,000 41.6/41.4, $10,000 81.2/80.9, $25,000 206.5/443.6, $50,000 417.9/3900.6. Its mid sat -19.6 bps from the feed.
assets.maxTradeNote: Proposed 2026-10-23. The largest size asked ($1,000, $2,500, $4,000, $5,000, $10,000, $25,000, $50,000, $250,000) that cost 1% or less each way in the v3 pool above at block 96096520, every smaller size too: 0.81% in, 0.81% out at $10,000; $25,000 costs 2.07% in, 4.44% out. App-side; the record can change it without the Safe.
assets.averageNote: Proposed 2026-10-23. The token's Uniswap v3 pool against USDG with the most liquidity in range among those keeping more than 3,600 observations, fee 500, the v3 factory's own (the fee-10000 pool is deeper and keeps 1,860). It keeps 3,601 observations (growing to 4,101) and observe([3600, 0]) answers, so usable is true, at the edge. minLiquidity is half its liquidity in range, 275587637415882901, down to two figures.
assets.hiddenNote: v3 route: listed, not shown until the app routes v3, as QQQ, MU, AMD, INTC and SLV (gate WIDER-LIST-B).
